connector.name: Starling Bank
connector.registryDescription: Allow AI systems to view and control your Starling Bank account via MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package starling-bank-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the domdomegg account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: STARLING_BANK_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Starling Bank personal access token. Sign up for the Starling Developer Portal, link your account, and create a Personal Access Token.

env.name: STARLING_BANK_PRIVATE_KEY_UID
env.description: Optional: Key UID of the signing key for sending payments.

env.name: STARLING_BANK_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM
env.description: Optional: PEM-encoded signing key for sending payments.
